devdoc.author: Tim Clancy <tim-clancy.eth>Rostislav Khlebnikov <catpic5buck.eth> This contract allows callers to stake their Neo Tokyo Citizens (both S1 and  S2) and BYTES for	time-locked emission rewards. The staker operates on a  point-based, competitive system where stakers compete for a finite amount of  daily emissions. It allows permissioned managers to configure various  emission details for the Neo Tokyo ecosystem.

In the event of staking BYTES or LP tokens, this parameter is the amount  of the respective token being staked.If the asset being staked is an S1 Citizen, this is the ID of  a Vault to attempt to optionally attach.If the asset being staked is an S1 Citizen, this is a flag to  attempt to claim a Hand of the Citadel bonus. devdoc.title: A pool-based staking contract for the Neo Tokyo ecosystem.

AmountExceedsCap(uint256,uint256).notice: Thrown when a BYTES stake would exceed the cap of its corresponding Citizen.

CallerIsNotBYTES().notice: Thrown if the caller of a function is not the BYTES contract.

CannotStakeIntoUnownedCitizen(uint256,ui.notice: Thrown when attempting to stake BYTES into an unowned Citizen.

CannotWithdrawUnownedS1(uint256).notice: Thrown when attempting to withdraw an unowned S1 Citizen.

CannotWithdrawUnownedS2(uint256).notice: Thrown when attempting to withdraw an unowned S2 Citizen.

CitizenAlreadyHasVault(uint256,uint256).notice: Thrown when an S1 Citizen with a component Vault attempts to stake while  attaching an optional non-component Vault.

CitizenDoesNotExist(uint256).notice: Thrown when attempting to operate on a non-existent Citizen (S1 or S2).

CitizenIsNotHand(uint256).notice: Thrown when an S1 Citizen attempts to wrongfully claim the Hand bonus.

InactivePool(uint256).notice: Thrown during staking if attempting to stake into an asset pool whose rewards  are not yet active.

InvalidAssetType(uint256).notice: Thrown during staking or unstaking if an invalid AssetType is specified.

InvalidSeasonId(uint256).notice: Thrown when attempting to stake BYTES into an invalid Citizen season.

InvalidTimelockOption(uint256,uint256).notice: Thrown during staking if an invalid timelock option is specified. Each  AssetType being staked may have independently-configured timelock options.

LockedConfigurationOfLP().notice: Thrown if attempting to configure the LP token address post-lock.

MismatchedTimelock().notice: Thrown when attempting to increase a stake in an asset without matching the  existing timelock of the asset.

NotEnoughLPTokens(uint256,uint256).notice: Thrown if a caller tries to withdraw more LP tokens than they had staked.

RewardWindowTimesMustIncrease().notice: Thrown when specifying invalid reward windows for a pool.

TimelockNotCleared(uint256).notice: Thrown when withdrawing an asset fails to clear a timelock.

UnconfiguredPool(uint256).notice: Thrown during staking if attempting to stake into an unconfigured asset pool.

UnknowablePosition(uint256).notice: Thrown when attempting to get a staker's position of an unknowable asset type.

Claim(address,uint256,uint256).notice: This event is emitted each time a recipient claims a reward.

ManagementUpdated(address,bytes32,bytes3.notice: An event emitted when a management relationship in `managerRight` is updated. This event captures adding and revoking management permissions via observing the update history of the `managerRight` value.

PermitUpdated(address,address,bytes32,by.notice: An event emitted when an address has a permit updated. This event captures, through its various parameter combinations, the cases of granting a permit, updating the expiration time of a permit, or revoking a permit.

Stake(address,address,uint256,uint256).notice: This event is emitted when an asset is successfully staked.

Withdraw(address,address,uint256).notice: This event is emitted when an asset is successfully withdrawn.

CONFIGURE_TIMELOCKS().notice: The identifier for the right to configure timelock options.

claimReward(address).notice: Determine the reward, based on staking participation at this moment, of a  particular recipient. Due to a historic web of Neo Tokyo dependencies,  rewards are actually minted through the BYTES contract.

configureCaps(uint256,uint256).notice: This function allows a permitted user to update the vaulted and unvaulted  Citizen BYTES staking caps.

configureIdentityCreditPoints(string[],u.notice: This funciton allows a permitted user to override the base points  associated with a particular S1 Identity "Credit Yield" string.

configureIdentityCreditYields(uint256[],.notice: This function allows a permitted user to configure the double mapping of  combined S1 Citizen reward rates and Vault reward credit multipliers  required to deduce the resulting S1 Identity "Credit Yield" strings.

configureLP(address).notice: This function allows a permitted user to configure the LP token contract  address. Extreme care must be taken to avoid doing this if there are any LP  stakers, lest staker funds be lost. It is recommended that `lockLP` be  invoked.

configurePools((uint8,uint256,(uint128,u.notice: This function allows a permitted user to set the reward emission and DAO  tax rates of the asset staking pools.

configureTimelockOptions(uint8,uint256[].notice: This function allows a permitted user to configure the timelock options  available for each type of asset.

configureVaultCreditMultipliers(string[].notice: This function allows a permitted user to override the S1 Vault multiplier  rates associated with a particular S1 Vault "credit multiplier" string.

constructor.notice: Construct a new instance of this Neo Tokyo staker configured with the given  immutable contract addresses.

getConfiguredVaultMultiplier(uint256).notice: The multipliers to S1 Citizen points contributed by their component Vaults  may be independently configured by permitted administrators of this staking  contract. This helper function returns any of the multipliers that may have  been configured.

getCreditYield(uint256,uint256).notice: Neo Tokyo Identity items do not expose their "Credit Yield" trait values in  an easily-consumed fashion. This function works backwards to calculate the  underlying "Credit Yield" trait value of the component Identity item of the  Neo Tokyo S1 Citizen with the token ID of `_citizenId` given the reward  rate of the S1 Citizen as a whole and the credit multiplier of any  component Vault.

getPendingPoolReward(uint8,address).notice: This function supports retrieving the reward and tax earned by a particular  `_recipient` on a specific pool of type `_assetType`. It is meant to be called by a frontend interface that needs to show pending rewards.

getStakerPosition(address,uint8).notice: Return the list of `_staker`'s token IDs for the specified `_assetType` if  that type is the Neo Tokyo S1 Citizen or S2 Citizen. In order to determine  the staker's position in the LP asset type, the public `stakerLPPosition`  mapping should be used. It is not valid to directly determine the position  in BYTES of a particular staker; to retrieve that kind of cumulative data  the full output `getStakerPositions` function should be used.

getStakerPositions(address).notice: Retrieve the entire position of the specified `_staker` across all asset  types in this staker.

getTotalEmissions(uint8,uint256).notice: Use the emission schedule of a particular asset pool to calculate the total amount of staking reward token emitted between two specified timestamps.

hasRight(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Determine whether or not an address has some rights under the given circumstance,

hasRightUntil(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Determine whether or not an address has some rights under the given circumstance, and if they do have the right, until when.

identityCreditPoints(string).notice: Assign a configurable multiplier to each S1 Citizen's Identity credit.

identityCreditYield(uint256,string).notice: This admin-configurable double-mapping allows us to deduce the Identity  "Credit Yield" string of a Neo Tokyo S1 Citizen given the Citizen's reward  rate and the reward rate of the Citizen's Vault.

lastRewardTime(address,uint8).notice: Track the last time a caller was granted their rewards for each asset.

lockLP().notice: This function allows a permitted user to forever prevent alteration of the  LP token contract address.

lpLocked().notice: Whether or not setting the LP token contract address is locked.

managerRight(bytes32).notice: An additional mapping of managed rights to manager rights. This mapping represents the administrator relationship that various rights have with one another. An address with a manager right may freely set permits for that manager right's managed rights. Each right may be managed by only one other right.

permissions(address,bytes32,bytes32).notice: A mapping of per-address permissions to the circumstances, represented as an additional layer of generic bytes32 data, under which the addresses have various permits. A permit in this sense is represented by a per-circumstance mapping which couples some right, represented as a generic bytes32, to an expiration time wherein the right may no longer be exercised. An expiration time of 0 indicates that there is in fact no permit for the specified address to exercise the specified right under the specified circumstance.

rewardAccrued(address,uint8).notice: Track the total reward amount earnings accrued to a particular caller.

setManagerRight(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Set the `_managerRight` whose `UNIVERSAL` holders may freely manage the specified `_managedRight`.

setPermit(address,bytes32,bytes32,uint25.notice: Set the permit to a specific address under some circumstances. A permit may only be set by the super-administrative contract owner or an address holding some delegated management permit.

stake(uint8,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint.notice: Stake a particular asset into this contract, updating its corresponding  rewards.

stakedS1(address,uint256).notice: A double mapping from a caller address to a specific S1 Citizen token ID to  the staking status of each S1 Citizen. This records the unique per-user  staking status of each S1 citizen.

stakedS2(address,uint256).notice: A double mapping from a caller address to a specific S2 Citizen token ID to  the staking status of each S2 Citizen. This records the unique per-user  staking status of each S2 citizen.

stakerLPPosition(address).notice: This mapping correlates each caller address to details regarding the LP  token stake of that caller.

timelockOptions(uint8,uint256).notice: This mapping contains the per-asset configuration of different timelock  periods with their associated multipliers. For each asset, the interior  mapping correlates a particular timelock option to a uint256 which encodes  the duration of the timelock in its upper 128 bits and the multiplier  offered by that timelock, as basis points, in its lower 128 bits.

vaultCreditMultiplier(string).notice: Assign a configurable multiplier to each S1 Citizen's Vault credit.

withdraw(uint8,uint256).notice: Withdraw a particular asset from this contract, updating its corresponding  rewards. A caller may only withdraw an asset provided they are the staker  and that timelocks are not violated.
